title: Weeknote #2018
content:
We've added new stickers to the St Jude fundraiser including a sparkly Jimothy. You're gunna want this one. Donate here.

We've got a new garage door going in next week which means I'll be able to actually use the space to it's full potential. I'm more excited than I should be.

Alex has been abusing ID3 chapters to make "video" podcasts by setting chapter art every few seconds. This is glorious and terrible and I love it.

I like the look of the Platinum Komono as a pen, but I am not a fan of any of the colours. Going to give this one a miss.

These mountain sticky notes are amazing but I can't justify the shipping cost. If they pop up in the UK somewhere, I'll be getting them.

Zach open-sourced his light/dark toggle component after I implemented mine. Rude.

Game UI Database is a fun resource.

Andy added an RSS feed that posts a random album from his collection every day.

My temporary PHP fix from 2014 has nearly 20M installs. Today I'm deprecating it. Fun story.

Wake up babe, new cat just dropped.
